title: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys
body:
Deal: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys

[Hamsahamsahamsa] Why isn't Coles trying to get me off? This is discrimination@!
[dlovep] No it's not, you can double dip… last week was 2800 point for $70.
[Onemoredeal] I realise you can , the algorithm is trying to get me to bite at a higher spend than $50 a week
[dlovep] You need to hand back your OZB badge if you only have "1" Flybuys…
[Hamsahamsahamsa] Those bastards recently lowered the amount to 2000 from 4000 flybuys , and increased the spend amount from $100 to $110. Woolies 10% off is better now.
[Hereforthegoods] 1.2k points for $30… Well that's one I've never seen before
[hasher22] They keep lowering the bonus points.
Mine used to be around 3k - 4k+ now it's always around the 2k mark, especially when my min spend is $120+
[HopSkipJumpFallSplat] I used to see $60/2000 but these days the lowest 2000 pt I've seen is $70 spend.
[xxssmmmmxx] Didn't get it on all cards. My "best" was 4800 on $110.
[EasyZZZ] I usually see this offer available to me, but I can't seem to find it in the app now. Is it too late to activate it, or was I simply not targeted for this round?
[HopSkipJumpFallSplat] It'll be visible today through to Tues, you weren't targetted if you can't see it.
